cases.name: keyword return
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "regular" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(items.sku, items.rank)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: double return
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "regular" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(items.score, items.rank)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: boolean return
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "regular" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(items.active, items.rank)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: integer key
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "regular" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(items.sku, items.seq)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: literal null return
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "regular" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(null, items.rank)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: typed null return
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "regular" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(null::keyword, items.rank)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: null value at maximum key
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "null_value" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(items.sku, items.rank)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: all null keys
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "null_keys" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(items.sku, items.rank)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: maximum key tie
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "ties" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(items.sku, items.rank)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: constant key
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "ties" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(items.sku, 1)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: literal null key
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "ties" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(items.sku, null)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: multivalued return rejected
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "mv_value" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(items.sku, items.rank)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: multivalued key rejected
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "mv_rank" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(items.sku, items.rank)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: scalarized multivalued key
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "mv_rank" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(items.sku, MV_MAX(items.rank))) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: scalarized multivalued return
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "mv_value" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(MV_MIN(items.sku), items.rank)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: double key rejected
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "regular" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(items.sku, items.score)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: empty scope selection
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "empty" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(items.sku, items.rank)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: minimum long key beats null
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "negative_keys" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(items.sku, items.rank)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: statically null return does not need key selection
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "mv_rank" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(null, items.rank)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: statically null SUM body
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "regular" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(SUM(CASE(items.rank > 0, null, null))) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: null-propagating value expression
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "regular" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(COALESCE(null::keyword, items.sku), items.rank)) | KEEP id, picked

cases.name: null-propagating ordering expression
cases.query: FROM nr_nested_selection | WHERE id == "regular" | EVAL picked = NESTED_ANY(LAST(items.sku, COALESCE(null::long, items.rank))) | KEEP id, picked
